Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Execution: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Work key: F03.2
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend engineer
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Remove the perpetual curator bypass and make policy changes serialize correctly with repository actions.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: F03 (bd-01M4W40JJBE0KQ3K3H365X8033)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Persist and evaluate current membership/stewardship/grant expiry and principal state inside authoritative transactions.
2. A context obtained before offboarding cannot accept, grant, resume publication or retrieve a protected receipt afterward; policy writes leave durable audit events.
3. Reference and SQL decisions agree; migrate old curator powers explicitly and retain successful idempotent acceptance semantics without returning unauthorized receipts.
4. Conform to O03.1’s policy-event and durability-ack contract in the same authoritative transaction; one migration authority owns shared schema and no later journal adapter may invent an incompatible authority history.
5. Provide O03.6 with a complete supported mutation/event inventory and the transaction adapter boundary for organization, grants, API credentials and invalidation. Local-only receipts remain explicitly local until O03.6 qualifies remote durability; partial event coverage cannot claim recoverability.

Verification: Independent-connection race tests, reference/SQL matrix comparison and regression of the existing transaction and HTTP authority suites.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/F03.2/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; no institutional or physical-failure qualification from same-host fixtures. Planning closes no implementation work.
